content.title: Exhibition Character Teaser | Micro-Performance, Module Relay and Event Lockup
content.summary: An adult toy designer and cat introduce an original small-worlds exhibition. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: Every human subject is clearly adult and original. + One border and palette system unifies all modules. + Each character card contains one bounded action. + The information card receives sufficient uninterrupted hold time. + No source title, date, logo or character design is copied.
quick_start.recommended_input: Introduce one clearly adult original toy designer and a small black cat in a mint character card. Cut to the cat blinking and lifting one paw inside the same border grammar. Cut to exact original title SMALL WORLDS, date 18 OCT and venue EAST HALL, held for three beats.
required_anchors: Every human subject is clearly adult and original.
One border and palette system unifies all modules.
The information card receives sufficient uninterrupted hold time.
No source title, date, logo or character design is copied.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult toy designer and cat introduce an original small-worlds exhibition. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 用两名原创成年风格化角色和一只动物伙伴建立可记忆动作卡；表情、挥手与同框按模块轮换，终局切到完整原创展览名称、日期和地点，角色不遮挡信息。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: Every human subject is clearly adult and original.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "Every human subject is clearly adult and original."

invariants.rule: One border and palette system unifies all modules.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "One border and palette system unifies all modules."

invariants.rule: Each character card contains one bounded action.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Each character card contains one bounded action."

invariants.rule: The information card receives sufficient uninterrupted hold time.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The information card receives sufficient uninterrupted hold time."

invariants.rule: No source title, date, logo or character design is copied.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "No source title, date, logo or character design is copied."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
